austin.summary: Austin, you drafted from the back of the snake and somehow walked away with a full house — four names, four still breathing, four points, and a share of first place. Every single one of your players sits at 1 pt, rank 1 of 21. That's not luck, that's balance. Ep 1 gave you +4 and nobody's given anything back. With 110 points still on the table and the leader at 4, you're right in the thick of it.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Linnea, Jenna, Carter and Eric are all sitting at 1 pts and all ranked 1 of 21, and Eric at pick #16 is the steal that makes this roster hum.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Linnea's the only B on a board of A's, so she's the one name on your card that hasn't fully separated herself yet.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Three of your four — Linnea, Carter and Eric — wear Savu buffs, so how that tribe holds up will swing your board more than anything Jenna does over on Toka.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the very first punch of this season — Aaliyah, your pick #3, went home in Episode 1, and the First Blood badge is yours to wear. But look closer: three of your four are still in this game, all three grading out at A, and you banked +3 in Ep 1. You sit rank 5 of 5 with 3 counted points, the leader has 4, and 85 points are still on the table. That's nothing, Kylie. Nothing.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: You've got a three-way tie at the top — Cristian, Alexis and Kilby each sitting on 1 pts and each ranked 1 of 21 — with Kilby at pick #18 as the outright steal of your draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 finished 21 of 21 with 0 pts and a grade of F, the first torch snuffed this season and the reason you're wearing First Blood.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Cristian and Alexis are both on Savu while Kilby carries Toka alone — watch how that split plays out with 85 points still on the table.

tami.summary: Tami, you had first pick and you built a faculty lounge with a swagger problem — a sociology professor, a federal prosecutor, a baseball executive, a gate agent, and an OB/GYN resident. All 5 of 5 are still in the game, you're sitting at rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 4 counted points, and the leader has 4. Draft GPA of 3.6, best week Ep 1 (+4), and 110 points still on the table. Perfect start.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's hogging the spotlight yet — all five are at 1 pts and rank 1 of 21 — but Sharonda at pick #21 is your steal of the draft, a leftover grading out at A.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Your very first pick, Angelica "Jelly" Loblack at #1, grades out at a C while the other four all sit at A, so the top of your board has ground to make up.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Three of your five — Jelly, Patt, and Mike — are stacked on Toka, so watch how that tribe fares while Rob and Sharonda hold down Savu.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and came away with a four-headed monster. All four are still in the game, all four are sitting at 1 pts, rank 1 of 21, and that adds up to 4 counted points — good enough for a share of rank 1 of 5. Ep 1 gave you +4, your best week so far. Draft GPA of 3.5, and Brady at pick #19 already ranks 1. There are 110 points still on the table.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody — Kristin, Ori, Ana and Brady each have 1 pts and each rank 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced haul that built your 4 counted points.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Kristin, your #2 overall pick, is the lone C grade on a roster of A's, and at 49 she's the oldest player out there facing a young, physical field.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Ana's tribe is still TBA — where that goofy, ambitious, chaotic voice actress lands could shape how the rest of your Savu-heavy roster stacks up.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and came away with two farmers, an actor, and a med student — and right now every single one of them is still in this game, 4 of 4. You're rank 1 (tied) of 5 with 4 counted points, and Ep 1 handed you your best week yet at +4. Thien An at pick #17 was the steal of the draft. Draft GPA: 3.75. Balanced, likable, dangerous.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's hogging the spotlight — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An each sit at 1 pts, all tied at rank 1 of 21, which is exactly how you build a 4-point week.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Lewis Kelly is your only B on a roster full of A's, and Devin Way's tribe is still TBA, so you don't yet know what world he's walking into.
